priorityList: Use Power Infusion, Potions, and Trinkets while Metamorphosis is active.
Cast Void Ray to maintain the Eradicate buff when facing 2 or more targets.
Cast Voidblade or The Hunt when you reach maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eradicate is active or against a single target.
Execute the Reap sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) when you have consumed 4+ souls during Metamorphosis, especially if Void Ray is almost ready.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are at or near maximum Collapsing Star stacks.
Cast Collapsing Star if Predator's Wake is on cooldown and you have the Dark Matter buff or Star Fragments talent.
Execute the Reap sequence if Voidfall is active or if Eradicate is up on multiple targets.
Use Vengeful Retreat if Voidstep is active, provided you are not over-capping Collapsing Star stacks.
Cast Hungering Slash when facing multiple enemies.
Cast Reapers Toll if Voidsurge is proc'd or when in an AoE scenario.
Cast Pierce the Veil followed by Predator's Wake as your high-priority melee filler.
Maintain Soul Immolation on targets whenever Metamorphosis is not active and there are multiple enemies.
Use Devour and Consume as low-priority fillers to generate resources.
